title: Risk-Sensitive Non-Parametric and Kernel Bandits
abstract: arXiv:2611.06489v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study non-parametric bandits in which arms are evaluated using Cumulative Prospect Theory (CPT) rather than expected reward. We consider continuous action spaces with arm-dependent noise and propose Non-Parametric CPT Bandits ($\mathtt{NPCB}$), an optimistic algorithm that decouples mean estimation from CPT-based decision-making. We prove CPT regret of order $\widetilde{\mathcal O}\bigl(\sqrt{T\,\dim_E(\mathcal F,T^{-2})\,\log N(\mathcal F,T^{-2},\|\cdot\|_\infty)}\bigr)$, where $\dim_E$ is the Eluder dimension of the function class $\mathcal F$, $T$ is the time horizon, and $N$ is its covering number in the sup norm. This matches the order-wise regret of classical non-parametric bandits, showing that CPT risk sensitivity incurs no additional order-wise regret cost. We extend $\mathtt{NPCB}$ to unknown noise CDFs, retaining the known-CDF mean-learning term and adding a CDF-learning cost governed by a distributional Eluder dimension.

translated_title: 风险敏感的非参数与核赌博机
translated_abstract: 我们研究了非参数赌博机问题，其中各臂（arm）采用累积前景理论（CPT）而非期望奖励来进行评估。我们考虑具有臂相关噪声的连续动作空间，并提出非参数CPT赌博机（$\mathtt{NPCB}$）——一种将均值估计与基于CPT的决策制定相解耦的乐观算法。我们证明了量级为 $\widetilde{\mathcal O}\bigl(\sqrt{T\,\dim_E(\mathcal F,T^{-2})\,\log N(\mathcal F,T^{-2},\|\cdot\|_\infty)}\bigr)$ 的CPT遗憾，其中 $\dim_E$ 是函数类 $\mathcal F$ 的Eluder维度，$T$ 是时间范围，$N$ 是其在无穷范数下的覆盖数。该结果与经典非参数赌博机的遗憾量级相匹配，表明CPT风险敏感性不会带来额外的量级遗憾代价。我们进一步将 $\mathtt{NPCB}$ 扩展到噪声累积分布函数（CDF）未知的情形，保留了已知CDF时的均值学习项，并添加了由分布Eluder维度所支配的CDF学习代价。
tldr: 本文提出NPCB乐观算法，将累积前景理论（CPT）风险敏感评估引入带连续动作空间的非参数赌博机，证明了其CPT遗憾与经典非参数赌博机量级一致，说明风险敏感性不带来额外的量级遗憾代价，并扩展至未知噪声分布的情形。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes NPCB, an optimistic algorithm for non-parametric bandits with continuous action spaces evaluated via Cumulative Prospect Theory (CPT), proving CPT regret matching classical non-parametric bandits order-wise—showing CPT risk sensitivity incurs no additional regret cost—and extending the approach to unknown noise distributions.
